card.name: Digits in numeric thresholds after ≥
card.fires_on: A digit inside a numeric cutoff, usually right after a ≥ or > sign. Seen in weight-gain percentages, fever temperatures, body weight and lab values.

modes.label: Weight gain cutoff
modes.description: The digit 7 in the percent weight increase threshold in antipsychotic trial data.
modes.example: the proportion of patients with an increase in weight ≥<<7>>% from baseline to end of study was

modes.label: Fever temperature
modes.description: A digit within a fever threshold given in °F or °C.

modes.label: Other cutoffs
modes.description: A digit in a weight, lab or gestational age limit.
modes.example: Pediatric patients who weigh ≥ <<4>>3 kg should receive the maximum daily dose
